風險管理                                       RISK MANAGEMENT
本集團業務已針對各主要固有風險訂定風險限額                      Risk limits or tolerances are set for the major risks inherent in the
或可承受水平，包括可量化風險，如信貸風險、                      Group’s operations, including both quantifiable risks such as credit
市場風險、流動資金風險及利率風險，以及不易                      risk, market risk, liquidity risk and interest rate risk, as well as less-
量化的風險，包括營運風險及聲譽風險。管理層                      quantifiable risks, which include operational risk and reputation risk.
定期監察該等限額及可承受水平，並向董事會層                      These limits and tolerances are monitored regularly by management

     若、公平且具競爭力之薪酬配套，並根據業務需                          packages for its employees, which are commensurate with market
     要、專業才能、個人之素質，且參照行業慣例與                          terms, and are based on business needs, expertise and quality of
     監管指引而訂立。                                       the individuals, and with proper reference to industry practice and
                                                    regulatory guidelines.


     就釐定支付予董事會成員之袍金水平而言，將會                          For determining the level of fees paid to members of the Board of
     考慮市場的袍金水平及各董事之工作量及其須作                          Directors, market rates and factors such as each director’s workload
     出之承擔等因素。釐定執行董事薪酬待遇之考慮                          and required commitment will be taken into account. The following
     因素如下：                                          factors are considered when determining the remuneration packages of
                                                    EDs:


     －     業務需要及表現                                  –      Business needs and performance


     －     整體經濟及商業情況                                –      The economy and business conditions in general


     －     個別對本集團之貢獻                                –      Each individual’s contributions to the Group


     －     風險相關之表現                                  –      Risk related performance


     －     參考與個人職責相符之市場薪酬水平                         –      Reference to market pay level commensurate with the individual’s
                                                           responsibility


     －     遵行監管指引                                   –      Consideration of regulatory guidelines

內部監控                        Internal Controls

董事會授權管理層負責制訂及維持健全之內部監       The Board has delegated to management the responsibility to develop
控制度。內部監控制度擬通過管理及營運監控、       and maintain a sound internal control system. The internal control
風險管理制度架構之運作，使董事會可監察本集       system, operating through a framework of management and operational
團之業務表現及財務狀況、監控及調節風險、採       controls, and risk management systems, is intended to allow the
納健全之業務守則、合理確證對欺詐及誤差之監       Board to monitor the Group’s business performance and financial
控、確保遵守適用法例及規則，以及對管理人員       positions, to control and adjust risk exposures, to adopt sound business
作出監察及提供指引，以達成本公司之目標。然       practices, to obtain reasonable assurance on controls against fraud
而，本集團之內部監控程序僅可對重大誤差、損       and errors, to ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations,
失或欺詐提供合理而非絕對之保證。            and to exercise oversight on and provide guidance to management in
                            achieving the Company’s objectives. However, it should be recognized
                            that the Group’s internal control procedures can only provide
                            reasonable, not absolute, assurance against material errors, losses or
                            fraud.

     風險管理及內部監控                                   RISK MANAGEMENT AND INTERNAL CONTROL
     董事會負責評估及釐定本集團達成策略目標時所                       It is the responsibility of the Board to evaluate and determine the
     願意接納的風險性質及程度，並確保本集團設立                       nature and extent of the risks it is willing to take in achieving the
     及維持合適及有效的風險管理及內部監控系統。                       Group’s strategic objectives, and ensuring that the Group establishes
     董事會並負責監督管理層對風險管理及內部監控                       and maintains appropriate and effective risk management and
     系統的設計、實施及監察。管理層須就該等系統                       internal control systems. The Board is also responsible for overseeing
     之有效性向董事會提交確認。                               Management in the design, implementation and monitoring of the risk
                                                 management and internal control systems. Management has to provide
                                                 a confirmation to the Board on the effectiveness of these systems.


     集團之風險管理及內部監控系統旨在管理而非消                       The Group’s risk management and internal control systems are
     除未能達成業務目標的風險，而且只能就不會                        designed to manage rather than eliminate the risk of failure to
     有重大的失實陳述或損失作出合理而非絕對的保                       achieve business objectives, and can only provide reasonable and
     證。該等系統包含一個完善的公司架構以及全面                       not absolute assurance against material misstatement or loss. Such
     的政策及標準。各業務及營運單位的職責範圍清                       systems comprise a well-established organisational structure and
     晰劃分，以確保有效監察和制衡。                             comprehensive policies and standards. Areas of responsibilities for
                                                 each business and functional unit are clearly defined to ensure effective
                                                 checks and balances.


     設定的程序旨在保障資產不致被非授權挪用或處                       Procedures have been designed for safeguarding assets against
     置；保存恰當的會計記錄；以及確保用作業務及                       unauthorised use or disposition; for maintaining proper accounting

3.2 信貸風險                  3.2 Credit risk

本集團之主要信貸風險為借款人或交易對手未能     The Group’s main credit risk is that borrowers or counterparties
履行對本集團之償款責任。此等責任乃源自本集     may default on their payment obligations due to the Group. These
團之貸款及投資活動、以及金融工具之買賣（包括    obligations arise from the Group’s lending and investment activities,
衍生工具）。                    and trading of financial instruments (including derivatives).


本集團設有集團信貸委員會（「集團信貸委員會」）   The Group has a Group Credit Committee (“GCC”) for approving major
負責批核重大的信貸風險敞口。信貸管理委員      credit exposures. The Credit Management Committee (“CMC”) and the
會（「信貸管理委員會」）與財資及投資風險委員會   Treasury & Investment Risk Committee (“TIRC”) are the committees
（「財資及投資風險委員會」）乃是分別負責制訂貸   responsible for credit policy formulation and portfolio monitoring of
款及財資業務之信貸政策及監察其組合之委員      the loan and treasury businesses respectively. These committees
會，該等委員會由行政總裁或風險總監擔任主席     have been chaired by the Chief Executive or Chief Risk Officer with
並由若干執行董事及高級業務及信貸人員組成。     certain Executive Directors and senior business and credit officers
信貸風險計量，承保、批核和監測之規定都詳列     as members. Credit risk measurement, underwriting, approval and
於信貸政策內。                   monitoring requirements are detailed in credit policies.


本集團以審慎基礎管理各類型的信貸風險。信貸     The Group manages all types of credit risk on a prudent basis. Credits
批核須規限在信貸政策所設定之參數之內，並且     are extended within the parameters set out in the credit policies and are
須由各級管理層人員按既定之指引及授權批核。     approved by different levels of management based upon established
管理層、信貸委員會及集團風險部會定期監察及     guidelines and delegated authorities. Credit exposures, limits and asset
控制信貸風險敞口、信貸限額及資產質素。本集     quality are regularly monitored and controlled by management, credit
團內部審核師亦會作定期檢閱及審核以確保信貸     committees and GRD. The Group’s internal auditors also conduct

                          and procedures, and regulatory guidelines.

        本集團應用市場風險數值法，其乃一                      The Group applies a VaR methodology, which is a
        種以統計為基準就持作買賣用途組合                      statistically based estimate, to measure the potential loss

        比市場風險數值之估計數為大。因此                      greater than the VaR estimate. Hence, the use of VaR does
        採納該方法並不能避免當市場狀況發                      not prevent losses outside the VaR limits in the event of
        生重大變化時超逾此等額度之損失。                      extreme market movements.

之損失的情況下為新增的資產融資或就到期之金       assets or meet its payment obligations associated with its financial

有關分項；而分項之間的資金運用及資金資源所          are reported directly under respective segments, while revenue

價格機制分配至各分項。分項間之交易乃依據授          funding resources are allocated to segments by way of transfer pricing
予第三者或與第三者交易之同類條款定價。分項          mechanism with reference to market interest rates. Transactions within

                               with external parties. Inter-segment income or expenses are eliminated
                               on consolidation.

類。間接開支及支援部門開支乃依據開支性質，          respective segments. Indirect costs and support functions’ costs are
按耗用之時間及工作量和分項營運收入，分配至          allocated to various segments and products based on effort and time
不同的分項及產品。不能合理地分配至各分項、          spent as well as segments’ operating income depending on the nature

於2021年12月31日，本集團在重慶銀行之投資之   At 31 December 2021, the fair value of the Group’s investment in
公平值已低於賬面值大約8年。為此，本集團持續      BOCQ had been below the carrying amount for approximately 8 years.
對在重慶銀行之投資之賬面值進行減值測試以評       On this basis, the Group continues to perform an impairment test on the
估可收回金額。                     carrying amount of the investment in BOCQ to assess the recoverable
                            amount.


減值測試比對以計算使用價值（「使用價值」）而釐     The impairment test is performed by comparing the recoverable amount
定之重慶銀行可收回金額和該投資之賬面值。使       of BOCQ, determined by a value in use (“VIU”) calculation, with the
用價值乃按照管理層估量之重慶銀行盈利和未來       carrying amount of the investment. The VIU calculation uses discounted
將派股息，及經考慮重慶銀行中期和長期之增長       cash flow projections based on management’s estimates of BOCQ’s
及資產淨值後之預期未來的可能脫手價值，應用       earnings and dividends to be paid in future, and the estimated probable
貼現現金流量預測計算。應用於使用價值計算之       exit value in future after considering the growth of BOCQ and its net
貼現率乃參考可於公開市場獲取之重慶銀行股本       asset value for the medium and longer term. The discount rate applied
成本而估算。                      to the VIU calculation was estimated with reference to BOCQ’s cost of
                            equity, which is publicly available in the market.


進行使用價值計算以得出該投資之可收回金額        In performing the VIU calculation to arrive at the recoverable amount
時，本集團考慮所有相關因素包括市場觀點及質       of the investment, the Group considers all relevant factors including
化因素以確保計算使用價值之參數合適。調整亦       market views and qualitative factors to ensure that the inputs to the
須作出以反映影響重慶銀行之最新情況及對預測       VIU calculation are appropriate. Adjustments need to be made to
重慶銀行未來表現有關之中期及長期市場展望。       reflect the latest situation affecting BOCQ and also market outlook for
在估算重慶銀行之未來現金流當中需要管理層作       the medium and longer term that are relevant in projecting BOCQ’s
重要判斷。                       future performance. Significant management judgement is required in
                            estimating the future cash flows of BOCQ.

      總體淨額結算安排                                                  Master netting arrangements

      本集團會盡可能與交易對手訂立總體淨額結算安                                     To mitigate credit risks, the Group enters into master netting
      排，以減低信貸風險。淨額結算協議規定，一旦                                     arrangements with counterparties whenever possible. Netting
      出現違約事件，所有涉及交易對手之未完成交易                                     agreements provide that, if an event of default occurs, all outstanding
      均會終止，而所有結欠款項將拼合按淨額結算。                                     transactions with the counterparty will be terminated and all amounts
      如非發生違約事件，所有與對手之交易會以總額                                     outstanding will be settled on a net basis. Except for the event of
      結算及一般不會在財務狀況表中對銷資產及負債。                                    default, all outstanding transactions with the counterparty are settled
                                                                on a gross basis and generally do not result in offsetting the assets and
                                                                liabilities in the statement of financial position.
